parameters.description: The last frame identity this reader saw, presented by the browser's own reconnect. An identity from another process, or one past the retained order, is answered with a `resync` event.
parameters.name: last-event-id

200.description: An ordered stream of invalidation events. Each frame carries an `id` of `<epoch>-<sequence>`, an `event` naming the topic, and a `data` object of exactly `sequence`, `subject` and `topic`. An event says what changed, never what it changed to: the reader refetches the authoritative answer over this same API. Reconnection is the browser's own, presenting the last identity as `Last-Event-ID`; an identity from a previous process is answered with a `resync` event rather than a position in this order.

get.summary: Subscribe to ordered invalidation for this session
